title: Feedstocks-to-Fuels Labman Solid Biomass Dispensing Protocol
author: Tad Ogorzalek

steps.title: Prepare Input CSV File
steps.instruction:
Create the Input Filename CSV file with four columns (A‑D). Column A must be the required label and not be modified. Column B = Source Rack Number (deck position of source rack). Column C = Source Vial position (1 = A1 bottom‑left, 96 = H12 top‑right). Column D = Dispensing method name. Fill the file exactly as shown:

steps.title: Prepare Manual Mapping CSV
steps.instruction:
Create the Manual Mapping filename CSV file with six labeled columns (A‑F):
A = OutputRack (deck position for destination plates, e.g., Micronic48 rack in “MTP Output Rack”);
B = OutputRackPosition (well number, A1=1, F8=48, bottom‑left corner =1);
C = InputRack (deck position of source rack, must match Column B of the Input CSV);
D = InputRackPosition (well number of source tube, same numbering as Input CSV);
E = DispenseWeight (g) – weight of biomass to transfer;
F = LiquidVolume (µL) – always set to 0 because liquid dispensing is not used.

Populate the file with the following rows (first block, DispenseWeight = 0.2 g):

steps.title: Create Output File
steps.instruction: Before each run, create a new output CSV file whose name includes the current date. This file will record intended vs. actual biomass transferred for each well and any errors that occur.

steps.title: Set Up Deck
steps.instruction: Place all source tubes and destination Micronic48 tubes on the deck in the positions specified by the CSV files. Close the deck doors completely; they will click into place. Press the large green button located next to the front emergency‑stop button. You should hear a second “hiss” confirming the robot is ready.

steps.title: Initialize Software
steps.instruction: If the Labman software is already open, click the “Clear Racks” button under Function Buttons to remove settings from any previous run. If you have just opened the software, click the “Initialize” button under Function Buttons to calibrate all electronics before the run.

steps.title: Select Process Mode and Vial Types
steps.instruction: In the user interface set Process Mode to “FeedingOnly”. Set Mapping Mode to “Manual”. Choose the Input Vial Type as either “Scintillation tube” or “Sarstedt tube” according to your samples. Set the Output Vial Type to “Micronic 48”.

steps.title: Setup Run
steps.instruction: Click the “Setup Run” button in the Function Buttons area. If the CSV files are correct, the wells containing source and destination tubes will be highlighted in beige.

steps.title: Start Dispensing Run
steps.instruction: Click the “Start” button in Function Buttons. Check all safety reminder boxes that appear, then click OK. The robot will dispense approximately 200 mg of biomass into each Micronic48 tube in about 1 minute; a full 48‑well plate therefore requires roughly 1 hour.
